data.exact_reserve_text:
The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. Corrective action has now been applied to this account to restructure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced.
The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures. Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2013 Year of Account Reinsurance to Close
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2013 underwriting Year of Account was reinsured to close into the 2014 Year of Account with a total recognised profit of GBP 6.3m (arrangements effective as at 31 December 2015); premium of GBP 1.3m payable in respect of the arrangement.

prior_year_events.event_name: Legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio deterioration
prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration in claims development on prior years' exposures led to strengthened reserves; Syndicate has exited the portfolio.

named_events.loss_description: Noted as one of the large losses in certain classes in which the Syndicate operates; managed within planned net claims expectations via reinsurance.
Noted as one of the large losses in certain classes in which the Syndicate operates; impact limited by outwards reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were GBP 418.878m. The syndicate's claims development triangle shows no material net prior-year movement on gross reserves for underwriting years up to 2013 (net movement ~GBP 0m), though management narrative describes adverse prior-year development particularly in Marine insurance segments and deterioration in a legacy Solicitor's PI portfolio which led to strengthening of reserves for those exposures. Named large losses in 2015 (Pemex, Tianjin) were primarily contained within planned net claims expectations through outwards reinsurance and did not materially change the aggregated prior-year gross reserve movement. RITC and SPS cessions and funds-withheld arrangements are noted and can distort simple comparisons.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary numeric prior-year movement was derived from the gross claims development triangle (notes) which yields effectively zero net movement for underwriting years up to 2013. This conflicts with narrative statements describing deterioration on certain prior years (Marine segments and Solicitor PI). The P&L line 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' was NOT used as per instructions (it is claims incurred, not reserve movement). RITC, SPS cessions (funds withheld) and multi-year reinsurance arrangements may distort reserve comparisons; where amounts were not explicitly quantified in the report, values are null.
